about.description:
PyGraphviz is a Python interface to the Graphviz graph layout and
visualization package. With PyGraphviz you can create, edit, read, write,
and draw graphs using Python to access the Graphviz graph data structure
and layout algorithms. PyGraphviz provides a similar programming
interface to NetworkX (http://networkx.github.io).

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.0.1"

package:
  name: pygraphviz
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/p/pygraphviz/pygraphviz-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 6f9850617f9444517641d2e14dfdb99ae8294cf7657be86c031fee8f7c54f863
  patches:
    - patches/lib-paths.patch

build:
  number: 1
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - pkg-config
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - python
    - setuptools >=78
    - swig >4.1.0
    - pip
    - graphviz
  run:
    - python
    - graphviz

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pygraphviz
        - pygraphviz.tests
      pip_check: true
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
    script:
      - pytest --doctest-modules --durations=10 --pyargs pygraphviz

about:
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Python interface to Graphviz
  description: |
    PyGraphviz is a Python interface to the Graphviz graph layout and
    visualization package. With PyGraphviz you can create, edit, read, write,
    and draw graphs using Python to access the Graphviz graph data structure
    and layout algorithms. PyGraphviz provides a similar programming
    interface to NetworkX (http://networkx.github.io).
  homepage: http://pygraphviz.github.io
  repository: https://github.com/pygraphviz/pygraphviz
  documentation: https://graphviz.readthedocs.io

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - nehaljwani
    - mgorny
